title: PAH-OMC-014 R-488 nonzeroity requires a positive source sector weight
question: Given the unchanged PAH-OMC-014 grade-blind ell_a cylinder with phi_0=0 and phi_1>0, what exact source-owned condition is necessary for a full-Q mixture or its limit to be nonzero?
finding: For symbolic nonnegative weights, the two-component finite value is exactly w_1 phi_1. Lean R502 proves it is nonzero if and only if w_1>0, and any positive lower bound on the mixture forces w_1>0. The R-492 finite Q=0 zero and Q=1 positive Gibbs witness instantiate the two signs. No weight is selected, fitted or adopted, so PAH-OMC-014 remains HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
decision_reason: R501 established non-identifiability of the finite full-Q mixture. R502 sharpens the missing-input contract for the required R-488 nonzero test: a source owner must provide not only a normalized sector law but also a nonvanishing weight/lower-bound statement for a positive component under the fixed limit order. This is conditional algebraic support, not a new Gibbs law or a universal projective no-go.
boundary: Auxiliary finite nonzero-weight obligation only. PAH-001 functional, rates, fixed-Q Gibbs states, OMC-012 graded domain/projection, OMC-014 limit order, R-484 defect 16/9 and R-490 C_sw=540 are unchanged. No projective consistency, Cauchy error, weak cylinder limit, global R-488 nonzero, stationarity, closability, semigroup, continuum or physical conclusion is claimed.
next_action: Obtain one source-owned normalized full-Q sector law or projective kernel together with a topology/Cauchy payload and an explicit lower-bound condition that survives the declared PAH-001 order; then replay the R500 projective bridge and the conditional limit/stationarity bridges.
method: Hash-pin PAH-001, PAH-OMC-012, PAH-OMC-014, its manifest and the R-492 finite graded-domain witness.
Enumerate the exact M_psi=1 assignments on the n=2 strip to establish ell_a=0 on Q=0 and an ell_a=1 state on Q=1.
Use finite counting Gibbs positivity to retain phi_0(ell_a)=0 and phi_1(ell_a)>0 without evaluating or fitting a sector weight.
Compile R502 under Lean 4.32.1 and check factorization, nonzero equivalence and the positive-lower-bound implication.
Run integrated, independent non-importing and hostile mutation verifiers; keep the parent gate at HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
assumptions: The unchanged PAH-001 finite fixed-Q domain has 0<=ell_v<=M_psi and sum_v ell_v=Q.
The declared n=2 strip contains the anchor ell_a and both Q=0 and Q=1 grades.
Finite counting Gibbs weights are strictly positive for every allowed state because the finite action and partition function are finite.
The R-492 Q=1 ell_a witness is in the unchanged grade-blind cylinder.
missing_assumptions: A source-authorized hash-pinned normalized full-Q sector law or equivalent projective kernel.
A source-owned topology and explicit Cauchy error under the fixed PAH-001 order.
A source-owned lower-bound or liminf condition on the positive R-488 component weight/value product.
A common stationarity domain and uniform-integrability estimate for omega(Lf)=0.

adversarial_review.check: Does R502 select w_1=1 as the PAH sector law?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: all weights are symbolic variables and the manifest marks source_law_present=false.

adversarial_review.check: Does a finite positive component witness prove a positive global limit?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: R502 only gives a necessary finite weight condition; topology, Cauchy control and a surviving lower bound remain missing.

adversarial_review.check: Does the lower-bound lemma use C_sw=540 or erase R-484?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: neither input is used; C_sw remains domination-only and the 16/9 defect is retained.

adversarial_review.check: Does this turn the conditional obligation into a universal no-go?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: it rules out only zero positive-sector weight for a positive global lower bound, not all future source laws.

non_claims: No full-Q Gibbs state, projective limit or positive normalized omega is defined.
No exact projective no-go for all cross-Q laws is claimed.
No infinite-volume semigroup, quantum real-time dynamics, physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion follows.
Markov time remains external stochastic time.
revisit_condition: Reopen when a source owner supplies the normalized sector law or projective kernel, its topology/Cauchy estimate, and a lower-bound payload for the positive R-488 component, or when an exact parent-scope counterexample invalidates the Q=0/Q=1 signs.
